acceptance_checks.then: it SHALL surface reader-facing post content below the hero rather than a hero-only landing
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `_site/index.html` contains a post-list region linking at least the most recent post permalink

acceptance_checks.when: a reader filters by any category present in the post corpus
acceptance_checks.then: every post SHALL be reachable through a non-"All" tab, never orphaned behind a phantom `storybook` tab
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the set of tab `data-category` values equals the set of categories used by posts; no tab maps to zero posts

acceptance_checks.then: the site SHALL publish a `/now` page that displays a visible last-updated date
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `_site/now/` renders and contains a "last updated" date string

acceptance_checks.then: the site SHALL publish a `/uses` page listing the current toolchain including the AI familiars
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `_site/uses/` renders and lists hardware or editor plus the AI tools such as Claude or local models

acceptance_checks.then: the site SHALL serve a 404 page rendered through an existing themed layout rather than the unstyled minima remnant
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `_site/404.html` renders with the site chrome; no reference to a missing `page` layout remains

acceptance_checks.given: a post whose body contains headings
acceptance_checks.when: the rendered page is loaded with JavaScript disabled
acceptance_checks.then: the table-of-contents region SHALL contain server-rendered links to those headings rather than an empty "Contents" shell
acceptance_checks.verify_method: JS-disabled fetch of a post shows `#toc-content` containing at least one anchor whose href matches a heading id

acceptance_checks.when: the operating system reports a reduced-motion preference
acceptance_checks.then: no script-created animated node SHALL be injected into the page DOM
acceptance_checks.verify_method: headless run with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` emulated over Home, About, Notebook, Laboratory, and Letter asserts zero script-injected animated nodes; `grep -rn "style.animation" assets/js/` shows every injection site behind a `matchMedia` reduced-motion guard
